title: Paired Shapes · Pair relay
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Paired Shapes · Pair relay with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose two players and agree on two simple shapes. Without speaking, the first player draws one shape and the partner draws the other beside it. Both agreed shapes appear side by side. Form pairs. On each pair’s turn, both people make separate attempts with fresh challenges, helping only their partner. The pair earns one point only if both succeed. Each pair has two turns. Highest score wins.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 4, 6 or 8 players; materials: Paper and pencil.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Paired Shapes, what counts as a successful turn?
options: Both agreed shapes appear side by side.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
recall.why: Both agreed shapes appear side by side.
